scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @ledger/sync-worker && npm run build --workspace @ledger/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @ledger/domain && npm run build --workspace @ledger/persistence && npm run build --workspace @ledger/plaid
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/local-d1 --config apps/web/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:recreate: npm run db:reset && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && npm run db:verify
scripts.db:seed: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/local-d1 --config apps/web/wrangler.jsonc --file fixtures/local-seed.sql --yes
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --coverage --config vitest.unit.config.ts && npm run test:coverage --workspace @ledger/web && npm run test:coverage --workspace @ledger/sync-worker
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration --workspace @ledger/web && npm run test:integration --workspace @ledger/sync-worker
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:browser && npm run build
